verses.text: Now all the tax collectors and the sinners were coming near Him to listen to Him.
verses.textZh: 眾稅吏和罪人都挨近耶穌，要聽他講道。

verses.text: Both the Pharisees and the scribes [began] to grumble, saying, 'This man receives sinners and eats with them.'
verses.textZh: 法利賽人和文士私下議論說：這個人接待罪人，又同他們吃飯。

verses.text: So He told them this parable, saying,
verses.textZh: 耶穌就用比喻說：

verses.text: 'What man among you, if he has a hundred sheep and has lost one of them, does not leave the ninety-nine in the open pasture and go after the one which is lost until he finds it?
verses.textZh: 你們中間誰有一百隻羊失去一隻，不把這九十九隻撇在曠野、去找那失去的羊，直到找著呢？

verses.text: 'When he has found it, he lays it on his shoulders, rejoicing.
verses.textZh: 找著了，就歡歡喜喜的扛在肩上，回到家裡，

verses.text: 'And when he comes home, he calls together his friends and his neighbors, saying to them, 'Rejoice with me, for I have found my sheep which was lost!'
verses.textZh: 就請朋友鄰舍來，對他們說：我失去的羊已經找著了，你們和我一同歡喜罷！

verses.text: 'I tell you that in the same way, there will be [more] joy in heaven over one sinner who repents than over ninety-nine righteous persons who need no repentance.
verses.textZh: 我告訴你們，一個罪人悔改，在天上也要這樣為他歡喜，較比為九十九個不用悔改的義人歡喜更大。

verses.text: 'Or what woman, if she has ten silver coins and loses one coin, does not light a lamp and sweep the house and search carefully until she finds it?
verses.textZh: 或是一個婦人有十塊錢，若失落一塊，豈不點上燈，打掃屋子，細細的找，直到找著麼？

verses.text: 'When she has found it, she calls together her friends and neighbors, saying, 'Rejoice with me, for I have found the coin which I had lost!'
verses.textZh: 找著了，就請朋友鄰舍來，對他們說：我失落的那塊錢已經找著了，你們和我一同歡喜罷！

verses.text: 'In the same way, I tell you, there is joy in the presence of the angels of God over one sinner who repents.'
verses.textZh: 我告訴你們，一個罪人悔改，在神的使者面前也是這樣為他歡喜。」

verses.text: And He said, 'A man had two sons.
verses.textZh: 耶穌又說：一個人有兩個兒子。

verses.text: 'The younger of them said to his father, 'Father, give me the share of the estate that falls to me.' So he divided his wealth between them.
verses.textZh: 小兒子對父親說：父親，請你把我應得的家業分給我。他父親就把產業分給他們。

verses.text: 'And not many days later, the younger son gathered everything together and went on a journey into a distant country, and there he squandered his estate with loose living.
verses.textZh: 過了不多幾日，小兒子就把他一切所有的都收拾起來，往遠方去了。在那裡任意放蕩，浪費貲財。

verses.text: 'Now when he had spent everything, a severe famine occurred in that country, and he began to be impoverished.
verses.textZh: 既耗盡了一切所有的，又遇著那地方大遭饑荒，就窮苦起來。

verses.text: 'So he went and hired himself out to one of the citizens of that country, and he sent him into his fields to feed swine.
verses.textZh: 於是去投靠那地方的一個人；那人打發他到田裡去放豬。

verses.text: 'And he would have gladly filled his stomach with the pods that the swine were eating, and no one was giving [anything] to him.
verses.textZh: 他恨不得拿豬所吃的豆莢充飢，也沒有人給他。

verses.text: 'But when he came to his senses, he said, 'How many of my father's hired men have more than enough bread, but I am dying here with hunger!
verses.textZh: 他醒悟過來，就說：我父親有多少的雇工，口糧有餘，我倒在這裡餓死麼？

verses.text: 'I will get up and go to my father, and will say to him, 'Father, I have sinned against heaven, and in your sight;
verses.textZh: 我要起來，到我父親那裡去，向他說：父親！我得罪了天，又得罪了你；

verses.text: I am no longer worthy to be called your son; make me as one of your hired men.''
verses.textZh: 從今以後，我不配稱為你的兒子，把我當作一個雇工罷！

verses.text: 'So he got up and came to his father. But while he was still a long way off, his father saw him and felt compassion [for him], and ran and embraced him and kissed him.
verses.textZh: 於是起來，往他父親那裡去。相離還遠，他父親看見，就動了慈心，跑去抱著他的頸項，連連與他親嘴。

verses.text: 'And the son said to him, 'Father, I have sinned against heaven and in your sight; I am no longer worthy to be called your son.'
verses.textZh: 兒子說：父親！我得罪了天，又得罪了你；從今以後，我不配稱為你的兒子。

verses.text: 'But the father said to his slaves, 'Quickly bring out the best robe and put it on him, and put a ring on his hand and sandals on his feet;
verses.textZh: 父親卻吩咐僕人說：把那上好的袍子快拿出來給他穿；把戒指戴在他指頭上；把鞋穿在他腳上；

verses.text: and bring the fattened calf, kill it, and let us eat and celebrate;
verses.textZh: 把那肥牛犢牽來宰了，我們可以吃喝快樂；

verses.text: for this son of mine was dead and has come to life again; he was lost and has been found.' And they began to celebrate.
verses.textZh: 因為我這個兒子是死而復活，失而又得的。他們就快樂起來。

verses.text: 'Now his older son was in the field, and when he came and approached the house, he heard music and dancing.
verses.textZh: 那時，大兒子正在田裡。他回來，離家不遠，聽見作樂跳舞的聲音，

verses.text: 'And he summoned one of the servants and [began] inquiring what these things could be.
verses.textZh: 便叫過一個僕人來，問是甚麼事。

verses.text: 'And he said to him, 'Your brother has come, and your father has killed the fattened calf because he has received him back safe and sound.'
verses.textZh: 僕人說：你兄弟來了；你父親因為得他無災無病的回來，把肥牛犢宰了。

verses.text: 'But he became angry and was not willing to go in; and his father came out and [began] pleading with him.
verses.textZh: 大兒子卻生氣，不肯進去；他父親就出來勸他。

verses.text: 'But he answered and said to his father, 'Look! For so many years I have been serving you and I have never neglected a command of yours; and [yet] you have never given me a young goat, so that I might celebrate with my friends;
verses.textZh: 他對父親說：我服事你這多年，從來沒有違背過你的命，你並沒有給我一隻山羊羔，叫我和朋友一同快樂。

verses.text: but when this son of yours came, who has devoured your wealth with prostitutes, you killed the fattened calf for him.'
verses.textZh: 但你這個兒子和娼妓吞盡了你的產業，他一來了，你倒為他宰了肥牛犢。

verses.text: 'And he said to him, 'Son, you have always been with me, and all that is mine is yours.
verses.textZh: 父親對他說：兒阿！你常和我同在，我一切所有的都是你的；

verses.text: 'But we had to celebrate and rejoice, for this brother of yours was dead and [has begun] to live, and [was] lost and has been found.''
verses.textZh: 只是你這個兄弟是死而復活、失而又得的，所以我們理當歡喜快樂。
